page.layout: One printed page, right of the gutter: running head at top with page number 103 at upper right; one column of text; closing line "Finis Libri primi," and signature line "E 4 IN-" below the text. Left edge shows show-through and the neighbouring page's margin fragments, not transcribed.

main_text.p: tatem motricem; verum cum facul- tas hæc cœca sit, dirigitur à phantasiâ & intellectu. Bruta enim animantia tantum habent appetitum sensitivum, & phantasiam; homo præter ista, intellectum & voluntatem. Ergo directio est à potentiâ cognoscente, appetitus vero movet membra, ad quæ à cerebro confluunt spiritus animales, quibus instructa moventur in hunc, aut illum locum. Atque hæc quidem breviter de primâ Medicinæ parte; quam tanto leviore brachio absolvi, quanto magis ad Philosophiam spectat.

page.notes: The left-hand strip shows show-through and fragments of the facing page; not transcribed. The signature "E 4" and catchword "IN-" are read from the foot; "IN-" is treated as a catchword fragment and may be the start of the next page's text. Head "INSTITVT. MEDICAR. LIB I." is the running head, not a heading.
